agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression: _ComplementSet.__lt__ in boltons/setutils.py had an inverted condition causing it to always return NotImplemented, breaking all '<' comparisons involving complement sets. Changed `if not (inc is NotImplemented): return NotImplemented` to `if inc is NotImplemented: return NotImplemented`, consistent with sibling __le__/__ge__/__gt__ methods. Verified fix manually across all internal branches (finite vs complement, complement vs complement, double-complement vs set) with no regressions in existing behavior.
